 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    target = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    sr = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in sr), max(r for r,c in sr)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in sr), max(c for r,c in sr)
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r,c in target), max(r for r,c in target)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r,c in target), max(c for r,c in target)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(tr0, tr1 + 1):
        for c in range(tc0, tc1 + 1):
            out[r][c] = grid[r0 + (r-tr0)][c1 - (c-tc0)]
    return out
"
